request.prompt:
Create ONE native editable static SVG packed study sheet, exactly 2160 by 768, viewBox="0 0 2160 768". 3 columns by 2 rows, cells exactly 720 by 384, no gutters. Row-major order of named subjects below. Each subject MUST be an individual top-level <g id="SUBJECT-ID" transform="translate(CELL-X CELL-Y)"> using LOCAL coordinates; every group owns its own full-cell dark background rectangle. NO cross-cell content. If there are five subjects, sixth bottom-right cell stays empty dark background in a group id="unused". Keep all subject geometry at least 30 units from cell edges, major silhouette occupies 65-80% of cell. All paint definitions must be local to the group or explicit flat fills. Do not use a shared sheet-wide backdrop.

These are FUTURE EXPANSION ART CONCEPTS for later review, not canonical history or active content. This is an engraved fantasy illustration set: confident irregular contours, expressive asymmetric gestures, three broad value groups, broad sculptural material planes before detail, sparse form-following engraving, no repeated tiny decoration. Connected joinery and credible support. Upper-left light, quiet background #10232c. Ink #10232c, shadow #34464b, worn ivory #ead7b5, muted bronze #b68d62, smoky steel #95a6aa. Emberwake adds moss #7c987a, saltglass #75a99f, restrained cinder #ca7658. Night Passage patron accents: Aster warm yellow #dfc777; Neris aqua #6dbfb0; Vesta coral #d78568; Isen pale ice blue #a5cbda; Nyra restrained lavender #a18cb8. Materials must look different: wood grain follows stress, leather folds, stone thickness, translucent glass has a clear rim and broad transmission planes, metal has restrained flat highlights. No plastic gloss, no golden edge on everything. Do not turn every object into a symmetrical emblem.

Each scene reads as one distinct designed subject at 360x192 and 180x96, and should survive a 64px silhouette glance for props. This is illustration art only: no frame, captions, labels, text, digits, watermark, logo or UI. Static SVG paths and simple shapes only; no raster embedding, image, text, use, CSS stylesheets, scripts, animation, external resources or filters. No inaccessible gradient references. Economical construction with large quiet areas.

SUBJECTS in exact row-major cell order:
Cell 1: id="aster-listening-alcove"; origin (0,0); Aster listening alcove. An intimate indoor listening recess: a stepped bronze acoustic hood bends over a single slate sitting ledge, one pale storm-gold slit light. Quiet open foreground and layered near/far planes; no combat arena or guardian.
Cell 2: id="neris-water-table"; origin (720,0); Neris water table. A sunken circular ceramic table filled with shallow aqua water, one pale shell-backed seat and dark reed curtain at rear; reflection shapes describe calm water. No archive books, lamp or combat arena.
Cell 3: id="vesta-bread-stone"; origin (1440,0); Vesta bread stone. A low warm basalt kneading slab under a copper heat canopy, one loaf-shaped plain clay votive on folded linen, a restrained ember recess at side; home-scale sanctuary, no furnace monument.
Cell 4: id="isen-quiet-ledge"; origin (0,384); Isen quiet ledge. A pale deep window ledge with folded blue cloth, one elongated ceramic vessel and cold light from a narrow off-center opening; broad quiet planes, no snowflake emblem or crystal lamp.
Cell 5: id="nyra-unseen-seat"; origin (720,384); Nyra unseen seat. An empty low stone seat partly sheltered by a heavy plum curtain folding diagonally from one fitted silver rail, one pale reflected plane and a quiet black recess. No eye icon, humanoid, guardian or gateway.

Keep each object composition distinct, readable and structurally grounded; the five Night Passage patrons have elemental/material affinities but these objects do not claim established lore or gameplay effects.

outputs.name: Aster listening alcove
outputs.note: Three asymmetric acoustic hood planes shelter a single ledge; a thin gold slit and broad diagonal light plane establish a quiet interior at 360×192 and 180×96.

outputs.name: Neris water table
outputs.note: Water reflection, shell-backed seat, low table rim and reed curtain remain distinct at both sizes. The scene composes a social recess rather than an arena or patron symbol.

outputs.name: Vesta bread stone
outputs.note: Supported copper canopy, low slab and folded linen form a clear warm interior. The clay loaf-shaped votive can read as ordinary bread; material identity needs a later art decision, with no canonical ritual implied.

outputs.name: Isen quiet ledge
outputs.note: Off-center cold window, pale ledge, elongated vessel and blue blanket form three quiet value groups. Window light and folds remain clear at compact plate size.

outputs.name: Nyra unseen seat
outputs.note: The diagonal plum curtain frames a grounded empty seat and dark recess. Fitted rail mount and broad stone planes stay readable; no guardian, gateway action or established lore is implied.
